drafts.angle: The ad factory needs a QC line (rides @gregisenberg 'CRACKED MARKETING 101', the most-saved post of the day)
drafts.draft_en:
AI agents can now ship 100+ static ads and a UGC video for $4 that used to cost $500.

Nobody's talking about the other side of that equation.

100 ads a day means 100 chances a day to break a brand rule, make an unsubstantiated claim, or trip a platform policy.

Creative got 100x cheaper. Review didn't.

That's why we built Aubric: every ad checked against brand, legal, and platform rules in seconds. Approve, fix, or block before a dollar of spend.
drafts.video_tip: 25s vertical screen recording: start on a grid of 100 AI-generated ads with the caption '100 ads. $4 each.' Run them through Aubric and let green, amber, and red tags fill the grid. Zoom on one red tag showing the exact policy it broke. End card: 'Cheap creative. Expensive mistakes.' Playbook-style posts earn saves, so close with 'save this before you scale your ad factory.'

drafts.angle: Per-deliverable pricing needs per-deliverable QA (rides @gregisenberg's '21% to 41%' launch observation)
drafts.draft_en:
New models went from doing 21% of real freelance work to 41% in one release.

Agencies are about to charge per deliverable instead of per hour.

Here's the catch: when you get paid per deliverable, every deliverable that gets rejected by a client's legal team or a platform's ad review is margin you just burned.

Per-deliverable pricing needs per-deliverable QA.

That's the layer we're building at Aubric.
drafts.video_tip: 30s talking head with on-screen numbers: '21%' then '41%' slamming in, then 'per hour' crossed out and replaced by 'per deliverable'. Cut to a quick Aubric check on a single ad with a FIX verdict and the rule cited. Hook in the first 2 seconds: 'Agencies are about to change how they charge.'

drafts.angle: Launch day is review day (rides the frontier-model launch wave: @rauchg 'astonishingly brilliant', @garrytan 'red letter day')
drafts.draft_en:
Every frontier model release day is a step-function upgrade for every creative team.

More variants. Longer agent runs. Unprecedented bodies of parallel work.

It's also a step-function upgrade in how fast a team can ship something off-brand, off-policy, or legally risky.

The smarter the generator, the more you need the reviewer to keep up.

We re-run our ad-review evals at Aubric on every launch day. Today's no different.
drafts.video_tip: 20s vertical: split screen. Left side labeled 'Generator' speeds up with a version counter ticking upward; right side labeled 'Reviewer' stays flat until Aubric kicks in and matches the pace. Caption: 'Launch day is review day.' Post it the same day as the next model launch to ride the wave.
